Step 2 — Wait for execution to settle

Step 2b — Classify this run against the backend ground truth (ArtifactAPI) before deciding which assertions apply (Known defect #1127 tie-breaker, mirrors ELITEA-2212/2213's backend-verified execution proof and the #611/#614/#615 soft_failures pattern in test_agent_publish_unpublish_version.py)
Side-channel check — no console/JS errors across the whole flow
